items.name: Soulcoiler Ritual Vessel
items.effectText: Use: Call forth 5 Soulcoiler Cultist spirits over 2 sec and sacrifice their essence, each granting an ally a barrier reducing damage taken by 50% for 20 sec or until ( 406015 * 1 ) damage has been prevented. Allied deaths reduce this cooldown by 30 sec and immediately summon a Soulcoil Cultist spirit for sacrifice. (2 Min Cooldown)

items.name: Sentinel's Vitriolic Chain
items.effectText: Equip: Damage taken from Deadly Venom on the Coiled Isle and within the Venomous Abyss reduced by 7%.

items.name: Keeper's Seething Core
items.effectText: Equip: Your attacks have a high chance to grant you Focus of Ula'tek, increasing your Haste by 132 for 12 sec. Multiple applications may overlap. When two or more applications are active, your focus sharpens further to increase the effect by 20%.

items.name: First Mate's Shellward
items.effectText: Use: Deploy the Shellward to absorb up to 40% of incoming damage until 553145 damage has been prevented for up to 30 sec. The Shellward hardens while you are below 40% health, reducing damage by 80% instead. Deal 22016 Physical damage to melee attackers while the Shellward holds. (1 Min, 30 Sec Cooldown)

items.name: Gebbo's Bottomless Bag
items.effectText: Equip: You have a chance to pull an artifact of questionable value out of the bag when casting spells and abilities, enhancing your secondary stats in various ways. There are probably no fish left in the bag, but it's hard to be sure. (750ms cooldown)

items.name: Vile Alchemist's Band
items.effectText: Equip: Damage taken from Deadly Venom on the Coiled Isle and within the Venomous Abyss reduced by 7%.

items.name: Fang of Umbral Malignance
items.effectText: Equip: Your harmful spells have a very high chance to befoul your target with Umbral Malignance, dealing ( 267 * 1 ) Shadow damage every 3 sec for 1 min, stacking up to 30 times. Umbral Malignance bursts upon the target's death, dealing 300% of its remaining damage split between nearby enemies and applying Umbral Malignance.

items.name: Vashnik's Sanguine Rancor
items.effectText: Equip: Your attacks have a very high chance to build sanguine rancor within you. After 15 times, the rancor erupts to scourge your target and all nearby enemies with crimson bile, dealing ( 101324 * 1 ) Shadow damage split between them. Damage increased by 30% per additional enemy, up to 150%. If only one enemy is struck, the concentrated bile deals an additional ( 101324 * 25 / 100 * 1 ) Shadow damage over 3 sec.

items.name: Apex Brute's Claw Ring
items.effectText: Equip: Damage taken from Deadly Venom on the Coiled Isle and within the Venomous Abyss reduced by 7%.

items.name: Idol of the Howling Nexus
items.effectText: Equip: Dodging, parrying, or blocking has a high chance to call bolstering winds, increasing your Strength or Agility by 571 and Speed by 148 for 12 sec. If you have not dodged, parried, or blocked for 15 sec, this effect is triggered immediately. May only occur once per 1 min.

items.name: Sszorak's Ferocity
items.effectText: Equip: You have a high chance to follow up your attacks with Ravage, Mutilate, or Tempest based on the number of nearby enemies. Your killer instincts are honed, triggering this effect on your next attack upon defeating an enemy. May only occur once per 10 sec.

items.name: Amulet of the Twin Fangs
items.effectText: Equip: Damage taken from Deadly Venom on the Coiled Isle and within the Venomous Abyss reduced by 7%.

items.name: Preternatural Antivenom
items.effectText: Equip: Your healing has a high chance to infuse the target with Preternatural Antivenom for 30 sec, healing your ally for 75% of any damage they take until 156661 health has been restored.

items.name: Vexhul's Everflowing Gland
items.effectText: Use: Unleash a deluge of caustic venom, dealing ( 57704 * 1 / 0.200000003) Nature damage to your target. Damage increased by 1% for every 1% health the enemy has remaining. Defeat enemies to catalyze their essential fluids into additional venom, reducing this cooldown by 5 sec. (3 Min Cooldown)

items.name: Maze-roa, Warlord's Fury
items.effectText: Equip: Your attacks have a high chance to apply Venomfang, dealing ( 1004 * 6 * 1 ) Nature damage over 6 sec before bursting to deal 2636 Nature damage to nearby enemies. Multiple applications may overlap.

items.name: Aman'muso, Warlord's Vengeance
items.effectText: Equip: Your attacks have a high chance to apply Venomfang, dealing ( 1004 * 6 * 1 ) Nature damage over 6 sec before bursting to deal 2636 Nature damage to nearby enemies. Multiple applications may overlap.

items.name: Hex Lord's Dooming Idol
items.effectText: Equip: Your spells afflict you with Hex Lord's Doom, draining your Intellect by 5 up to 30 times. This effect may occur once every 6 sec. (6s cooldown) Use: Consume the power of Hex Lord's Doom, increasing your Intellect by 34 per stack for 30 sec. (30 Sec Cooldown)

items.name: Zul'jin's Guillotine Technique
items.effectText: Equip: You have a chance to follow up your attacks with Guillotine, hurling a massive axe in an arc at your target to deal ( 50541 * 1 ) Physical damage. Damage increased by 2% for every 1% health the target is missing.

items.name: Abyssal Broodfiend's Bardiche
items.effectText: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to increase your Mastery by 378 , but reduce your other secondary stats by 63 for 12 sec.

items.name: Zatha'tek, Breath of Corruption
items.effectText: Equip: Your attacks have a chance to inflict Breath of Corruption, dealing ( 16655 * 1 ) Nature damage and rending a Necrotic Tear that persists until death and increases the damage of this effect by 5%, up to 10 times.

items.name: Jan'thrazet, the Soul Fang
items.effectText: Equip: Your spells have a chance to drain a nearby enemy's will, reducing their cast speed by 10% and increasing your Haste by 138 for 12 sec.

items.name: Jaw of the Shackled Goddess
items.effectText: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to increase your Haste by 378 , but reduce your other secondary stats by 63 for 12 sec.

items.name: Caustic Repose Greatbow
items.effectText: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to increase your Critical Strike by 378 , but reduce your other secondary stats by 63 for 12 sec.

items.name: Gaze of the Coiled Watcher
items.effectText: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to increase your Haste by 378 , but reduce your other secondary stats by 63 for 12 sec.

items.name: Venomkeeper's Horrific Cowl
items.effectText: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to increase your Mastery by 378 , but reduce your other secondary stats by 63 for 12 sec.

items.name: Aqirbane Reliquary
items.effectText: Equip: Damage taken from Deadly Venom on the Coiled Isle and within the Venomous Abyss reduced by 7%. Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to increase your Critical Strike by 378 , but reduce your other secondary stats by 63 for 12 sec.

items.name: Awoken Dreadfang Cuirass
items.effectText: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to increase your Critical Strike by 378 , but reduce your other secondary stats by 63 for 12 sec.

items.name: Chausses of Unbound Rancor
items.effectText: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to increase your Mastery by 378 , but reduce your other secondary stats by 63 for 12 sec.

items.name: Font of Venomous Rage
items.effectText: Use: Channel a torrent of venomous rage over 2 sec, dealing ( 1 * 906988 ) Nature damage to your target and splattering all nearby enemies for ( 1 * 159616 ) Nature damage. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets. (4 Min Cooldown)

items.name: Voracious Heart of Ula'tek
items.effectText: Use: Bite the heart and embrace the ravening hunger, gaining 480 Strength or Agility for 20 sec. While the hunger persists, gain a very high chance to devour a morsel of your target with every attack, dealing 15990 Physical damage and further increasing your Strength or Agility by 54 . (1 Min, 30 Sec Cooldown)
